itemsSent.title: Iran Says It Will Take Action Against Sinokor Ships in Hormuz
itemsSent.why: Geopolitical tensions in the Strait of Hormuz threaten vital oil shipping lanes, adding a slight risk premium to crude prices.

itemsSent.title: Oil prices fall amid diplomatic push to de-escalate Saudi-Iran tensions
itemsSent.why: Diplomatic efforts to de-escalate Middle East tensions reduce geopolitical risk premiums, pushing crude prices lower.

itemsSent.title: Russia Ships Less Crude Even as Key Baltic Port’s Flows Rebound
itemsSent.why: Lower overall Russian crude shipments despite Baltic port recovery signals tightening short-term supply, offering modest support to prices.

itemsSent.title: Russia’s Crude Exports Set to Fall as Diesel Production Rises
itemsSent.why: Lower Russian crude exports are bullish for crude, but increased domestic refining and diesel production are bearish for products.

itemsSent.title: The Diesel Crisis Is Here To Stay
itemsSent.why: Persistent Middle East conflict and damaged Russian refineries keep global diesel supply tight through 2027, supporting higher heating oil prices.

itemsSent.title: US Crude Oil Inventories Buck Analyst Expectations
itemsSent.why: API reported a 2.031 million barrel draw in US crude inventories, signaling steady demand and supporting near-term crude prices.

itemsSent.title: Speculators hike net-long positions in Brent
itemsSent.why: Money managers increased net-long bets on ICE Brent futures, reflecting mild positive sentiment, though largely backward-looking positioning data.
